brief: The canvas presents a colossal, immersive view into an abandoned college campus, defined by stark, geometric brutalist architecture. The primary palette features muted, cool greys of decaying concrete, dramatically contrasted by vibrant emerald and jade greens of invasive moss and creeping vines. The scene is constantly animated by a smooth, cinematic glide, simulating a drone's flight through the structural depths. As the movement proceeds, sections of the massive walls crumble away, revealing rusty rebar and the intricate texture of decay beneath the lush, organic growth. There is no interactive input required; the environment's journey unfolds continuously and autonomously.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive drone flight through a decaying college campus, blending brutalist architecture with lush organic growth. The scene features massive concrete structures rendered in muted greys, punctuated by vibrant moss and vines in emerald greens that contrast the cold geometry. Through a continuous cinematic camera movement, viewers experience the environment's journey as walls crumble away, revealing rusted rebar beneath the invasive plant life. The animation unfolds autonomously without any user interaction, simulating an aerial exploration of this abandoned space where nature has reclaimed the architectural remnants.
